Store terms

Terms of use.

The current site is a frontend storefront. It does not accept payment, create an order or confirm an appointment.

Product information

Descriptions are informational and must be reconciled with verified packaging, ingredient, price and inventory data before live sales. Final product labels take precedence.

Health information

Nothing on the site is medical advice. Consult an appropriately qualified professional when suitability depends on medication, pregnancy, nursing, allergies or a health condition.

Requests

A bag or form acknowledgement does not form a sales contract. An order exists only after the business provides and accepts verified order terms through a connected commerce service.

Intellectual property and accuracy

Brand copy, photography licences and product data should be reviewed by the operator before commercial launch.

Final review

Applicable law, business identity, dispute process and governing jurisdiction must be supplied by the operator and reviewed by counsel.
